title: Take-up Rates and Usage Patterns for $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid Career) Top-up
what_it_is: Take-up Rates and Usage Patterns for $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid Career) Top-up

sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit Mid-Career usage
sections.summary: Over 25,000 Singaporeans aged 40 and above used the $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top-up as of 30 November 2024, mostly in information and communication technologies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Since receiving the $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career) top-up on 1 May 2024, more than 25,000 Singaporeans aged 40 and above have utilised the credit as of 30 November 2024.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The top area of training in these first seven months was in information and communication technologies, covering skills such as digital marketing and data visualisation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Other popular areas of training include security and investigation, and wholesale and retail trade.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The top training providers include both the Institutes of Higher Learning (IHLs) and private training providers, such as NTUC LearningHub.

sections.label: Finding eligible courses and advisory
sections.summary: Individuals can use the MySkillsFuture portal and SSG's free Skills and Training Advisory services, the $4,000 credit has no expiry date, and over 7,000 courses are eligible.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Individuals can use the MySkillsFuture portal to find eligible courses and tap on SSG’s free Skills and Training Advisory services for personalised guidance to identify suitable courses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: There is no expiry date for the $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career).

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Today, over 7,000 courses that support substantive training are eligible for the $4,000 SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career).

sections.label: Curated courses for employment outcomes
sections.summary: About 7,000 courses have been curated carefully, known to provide better employment outcomes in getting jobs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The number of courses that have been curated is about 7,000 at the moment and we have been quite careful in curating them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: These are the ones that have been known to provide better employment outcomes in getting jobs.
